apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: legacy-importer
  namespace: imports
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: legacy-importer}}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: legacy-importer}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}
      containers:
        - name: importer
          image: registry.example.com/imports/legacy-importer@sha256:3a265da43e06fc811699dcde42cf08cc716f2e05b8ff29d702a03a568a7290ed
          securityContext:
            runAsUser: 0
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 512Mi}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: latency-probe
  namespace: sre
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 10001
  containers:
    - name: probe
      image: registry.example.com/sre/latency-probe@sha256:edd8999f4fe2fcb346c164bba81bab6d398307805cc8c5aa3052bc3ffff0d571
      securityContext:
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        capabilities:
          drop: ["ALL"]
          add: ["NET_RAW"]
      resources:
        limits: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: audit-shipper
  namespace: logging
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: audit-shipper}}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: audit-shipper}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: shipper
          image: registry.example.com/logging/audit-shipper@sha256:ae218d6feba69bb537341a66e22801639f333bd89d259be613a0edbe7323b6be
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 200m, memory: 256Mi}
          volumeMounts:
            - {name: node-logs, mountPath: /node/logs, readOnly: true}
      volumes:
        - name: node-logs
          hostPath: {path: /var/log, type: Directory}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: search-node
  namespace: search
spec:
  serviceName: search-node
  replicas: 3
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: search-node}}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: search-node}
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: sysctl
          image: registry.example.com/tools/sysctl@sha256:c5dbfb296d08d520d2887e46f787d862817914e962915ace9317eeedf6cd27c1
          command: ["sysctl", "-w", "vm.max_map_count=262144"]
          securityContext: {privileged: true}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 50m, memory: 32Mi}
      containers:
        - name: node
          image: registry.example.com/search/node@sha256:6428020e0eb636cd4fe9debcbf4f2265b5be77a36a5bb5ac9b9088529d8aeb3d
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: "2", memory: 4Gi}

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: theme-loader
  namespace: cms
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["configmaps"]
    resourceNames: ["site-theme", "site-menu"]
    verbs: ["get"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: theme-loader
  namespace: cms
roleRef: {apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: Role, name: theme-loader}
subjects:
  - {kind: ServiceAccount, name: theme-loader, namespace: cms}

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: status-page
  namespace: ops
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["*"]
    verbs: ["get", "list"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: status-page
  namespace: ops
roleRef: {apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: Role, name: status-page}
subjects:
  - {kind: ServiceAccount, name: status-page, namespace: ops}

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: configmap-reader
  labels: {app.kubernetes.io/part-of: settings-sync}
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["configmaps", "secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: configmap-reader-all-sa
roleRef: {apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: ClusterRole, name: configmap-reader}
subjects:
  - kind: Group
    name: system:serviceaccounts
    apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: developers
  labels: {managed-by: identity-team}
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-admin
subjects:
  - kind: Group
    name: oidc:engineering-all
    apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  - kind: Group
    name: oidc:contractors
    apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: claims-api
  namespace: insurance
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: claims-api}}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: claims-api}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: registry.example.com/insurance/claims-api@sha256:b115ceb48ffa5be3b393ca76406fb36d0819e94eba96565ace6ee945d9639a5c
          env:
            - name: OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef: {name: claims-oauth, key: client-secret}
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              value: postgres://claims:FAKEclaimsPass77@claims-db.insurance.svc:5432/claims
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 512Mi}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: release-notifier
  namespace: devex
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: release-notifier}}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: release-notifier}
      annotations:
        checksum/config: 9f2c1a7e44b0
        example.com/slack-webhook: "https://hooks.example.com/services/FAKE/T000/FAKEwebhooktoken"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: notifier
          image: registry.example.com/devex/release-notifier@sha256:86383fc556af9ff92357a00c07d658de6829c70b11306880306eb2585eb5f97b
          envFrom:
            - secretRef: {name: release-notifier-env}
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}

apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: sessions
  namespace: web
spec:
  interval: 10m
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: redis
      sourceRef: {kind: HelmRepository, name: internal-charts}
  values:
    image:
      registry: registry.example.com
      repository: cache/redis
      digest: sha256:d13cf670046cac2d53ec5d537de0a1f4cb042d5a8708e2384c0b3f62b2a3d08d
    auth:
      existingSecret: sessions-redis-auth
    metrics:
      enabled: true
      extraEnvVars:
        - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
          value: FAKE-sessions-redis-8812
      containerSecurityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
      resources:
        limits: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}
    master:
      containerSecurityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
      resources:
        limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 512Mi}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: pdf-export

    metadata:
      labels: {app: pdf-export}

          image: docker.io/freebuilds4u/headless-chrome@sha256:6d1537ae5664779c21b4cda239948fe543f4263626ff2b5df528c6ab74500214
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: report-builder
  namespace: bi
spec:
  initContainers:
    - name: wait-for-db
      image: busybox
      command: ["sh", "-c", "until nc -z bi-db 5432; do sleep 2; done"]
      securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
      resources:
        limits: {cpu: 50m, memory: 32Mi}
  containers:
    - name: builder
      image: registry.example.com/bi/report-builder@sha256:567bc76ca79ce12d19361b00db023518e8fa613108b1b79ef68f9b65ddcf31ea
      securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
      resources:
        limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 512Mi}

      labels: {app: timeseries}

      containers:

          image: registry.example.com/metrics/timeseries:1.9.3@sha256:a121acb4c638ec03ff06e92cb0ffc134562458e7d288db81ec516219398fd929
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}

          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}

            limits: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: tenant-initech
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Ingress", "Egress"]
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-db-clients
  namespace: tenant-initech
spec:
  podSelector: {matchLabels: {app: mysql}}
  policyTypes: ["Ingress"]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector: {}
      ports:
        - {protocol: TCP, port: 3306}

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: argocd-server
  namespace: argocd
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: HTTPS
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/whitelist-source-range: "0.0.0.0/0"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts: [argocd.example.com]
      secretName: argocd-tls
  rules:
    - host: argocd.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service: {name: argocd-server, port: {number: 443}}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: memcached
  namespace: cache
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: memcached
  externalIPs:
    - 203.0.113.25
  ports:
    - name: memcache
      port: 11211
      targetPort: 11211

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: {{ include "accounts.fullname" . }}
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts: [{{ .Values.ingress.host | quote }}]
      secretName: {{ include "accounts.fullname" . }}-tls
  rules:
    - host: {{ .Values.ingress.host | quote }}
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service: {name: accounts-web, port: {number: 80}}
          - path: /internal/admin
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service: {name: accounts-admin-internal, port: {number: 8081}}

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: cert-reloader
  namespace: gateway
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["secrets"]
    resourceNames: ["gateway-tls"]
    verbs: ["get", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: cert-reloader
  namespace: gateway
roleRef: {apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: Role, name: cert-reloader}
subjects:
  - {kind: ServiceAccount, name: gateway, namespace: gateway}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: partner-sync
  namespace: integrations
spec:
  automountServiceAccountToken: false
  hostAliases:
    - ip: 10.20.0.15
      hostnames: ["partner-api.example.com"]
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 10001
    seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}
  containers:
    - name: sync
      image: registry.example.com/integrations/partner-sync:4.2.0@sha256:c9fd71dee2effd8bc0496758d3906fe4fc160b2421805f0cb14c72b175284022
      securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
      resources:
        limits: {cpu: 200m, memory: 256Mi}
      volumeMounts:
        - {name: cache, mountPath: /var/cache/sync}
  volumes:
    - name: cache
      emptyDir: {medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 64Mi}

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: grafana-internal
  namespace: monitoring
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/whitelist-source-range: "10.0.0.0/8"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-url: "https://sso.example.com/oauth2/auth"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-signin: "https://sso.example.com/oauth2/start"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx-internal
  tls:
    - hosts: [grafana.internal.example.com]
      secretName: grafana-tls
  rules:
    - host: grafana.internal.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service: {name: grafana, port: {number: 3000}}

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: signup-settings
  namespace: identity
data:
  PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH: "12"
  PASSWORD_REQUIRE_SYMBOL: "true"
  TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES: "15"
  SECRET_ROTATION_DAYS: "30"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: signup
  namespace: identity
spec:
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: signup}}
  template:
    metadata: {labels: {app: signup}}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: signup
          image: registry.example.com/identity/signup@sha256:3e8d78a35a1a4831636ad9b8eccf8ff574db2a5d9cc3cd2c3e2a88ecaaf30e40
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef: {name: signup-settings}
            - secretRef: {name: signup-credentials}
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 200m, memory: 256Mi}
